name: Zoom Controls
author: vedacool
description: Bar pill for the Zoom desktop app while sharing: tucks Zoom's big share toolbar away, one click brings it back (Audio, Video, Stop share), and keeps Zoom's other windows from blocking its clicks. Idea from jkarmel/omarchy-zoom-controls (MIT), which only supports the web app.

barWidget.description: Show or hide Zoom's share toolbar while sharing
